bio.text: Julia Letlow represents Louisiana's 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, having taken office in April 2021 after winning a special election.
A native of Monroe, she earned bachelor's and master's degrees in speech communication from the University of Louisiana Monroe and a doctorate in communication from the University of South Florida.
She previously worked in university administration at the University of Louisiana Monroe, including as executive director of external affairs and strategic communications from 2018 to 2019.
